guides.title: Car braked or warned with nothing ahead
guides.summary: Automatic emergency braking or the collision warning came on although there was nothing to hit.
symptoms: car braked suddenly with nothing in front
car jerked and braked by itself
AEB activated with no car ahead
brake warning beeps on an empty road

steps.text: Did the car hit anything, or was anyone hurt?
If anyone is hurt, call 112 now. Switch on the hazard lights, keep everyone away from traffic, and inform your insurer.
steps.detail: Then report what happened below: your report helps the engineers find the cause.

steps.text: What did the car do?

options.label: It braked hard on its own
It only beeped or showed a warning

steps.text: Where did it happen?

options.label: Under a sign gantry or at a toll plaza

steps.text: This isn't something you can fix yourself, and it isn't your fault. Radar and camera systems can mistake a flyover, a metal plate, a sign gantry or a shadow for an obstacle.
steps.detail: Keep the system switched on: in a real emergency it can prevent a crash. Keep a safe distance and stay alert where it happened.

steps.text: Clean the windscreen in front of the camera (behind the rear-view mirror) and the radar sensor (in the front grille or badge), and remove anything in front of them: a dashcam, a sticker, a number plate frame.
steps.detail: A dirty or blocked sensor can misjudge what's ahead.

steps.text: If your car lets you choose the collision warning distance (Near, Normal or Far), choose Normal or Near for fewer early warnings. Don't switch the system off.
steps.detail: The setting is usually under Vehicle settings > Driver assistance. Automatic emergency braking stays active.

steps.text: Report it so the engineers can investigate, and ask the service centre to read the driver-assistance fault memory and check the sensor alignment.

escalate.text: Report it to the manufacturer and book a service visit.
tell_service: Date, time and place where it happened
Your speed and what was ahead: nothing, a flyover, a metal plate, a car in the next lane
Whether it happened before at the same place
Any recent windscreen replacement or front bumper repair (the sensors then need recalibration)

guides.title: Collision warning or automatic braking didn't react
guides.summary: The car didn't warn or brake automatically when you expected it to.
symptoms: automatic emergency braking did not work
emergency braking failed to stop the car

steps.text: Did the car hit anything, or was anyone hurt?
If anyone is hurt, call 112 now. Switch on the hazard lights, keep everyone away from traffic, and inform your insurer.
Where did it happen?

options.label: In a parking area or slow traffic

steps.text: Driver-assistance systems help, but they don't replace the driver. They have limits: some speeds, bikes and people at night, sudden cut-ins, sharp bends, heavy rain or a dirty sensor.
steps.detail: Your owner's manual lists your car's limits.

steps.text: Check the system is switched on in the driver-assistance settings, and whether a message such as 'camera blocked' or 'radar unavailable' was shown.
Clean the windscreen in front of the camera and the radar sensor, and remove anything in front of them.
Report it: whether the system should have reacted is for the engineers to judge from the data. Ask the service centre to read the fault memory.

escalate.text: Report it to the manufacturer and book a service visit.
tell_service: Your speed and what was ahead
Any warning message shown before or after

guides.title: Driver assistance unavailable, or 'camera blocked'
guides.summary: A message says the camera or radar is blocked or unavailable, or ADAS features switched themselves off.

steps.text: Clean the windscreen in front of the camera (behind the mirror), inside and out, and the radar sensor in the grille or badge.
Remove anything in front of the sensors: a dashcam, a tag or sticker, a number plate frame, a bumper guard.
Wait for better conditions and drive for a few minutes.
steps.detail: Heavy rain, fog, dust, low sun or a very dark road can switch the system off for a while; it comes back by itself.

steps.text: Was the windscreen replaced or the front bumper repaired recently?
The camera or radar must be recalibrated after a windscreen replacement or bumper repair. Ask the workshop that did the repair or the service centre.
Switch the car off, lock it for 5 to 10 minutes and start again.

escalate.text: If the message stays, the system has a fault: book a service visit.
tell_service: When it appears: weather, time of day

guides.title: Lane keeping steers on its own, or doesn't work
guides.summary: The steering wheel moves or vibrates by itself, the lane warning beeps, or lane keeping does nothing.
symptoms: lane keep assist pulling the steering
car steers on its own on the highway
steering apne aap ghoom raha hai

steps.text: Lane keeping uses the camera to follow lane markings. It gently steers or vibrates the wheel when you drift over a line without the indicator on.
Use the indicator when you change lanes; the system then doesn't correct you.
Keep both hands on the wheel; many systems warn or switch off if they don't feel your hands.
On roads with faded, double or temporary markings, switch lane keeping off for the trip with its button or setting; it's usually back on at the next start.
steps.detail: Road works and tar repair lines confuse the camera.

steps.text: Clean the windscreen in front of the camera.

escalate.text: If it steers when the lane markings are clear, book a service visit.
tell_service: Where it happened and how the markings looked
Whether it steers or only warns

guides.title: Adaptive cruise control won't switch on, or brakes too much
guides.summary: Adaptive cruise is unavailable, switches itself off, or slows down more than expected.
symptoms: adaptive cruise switches off by itself

steps.text: Check the conditions: most systems need a minimum speed (often around 30 km/h), doors closed, seat belt on, no brake pressed, and stability control (ESP) on.
Clean the radar sensor and the windscreen in front of the camera.
If it brakes too much, change the following distance with the distance button.
steps.detail: A car cutting in close will always make it slow down.

steps.text: Switch the car off, lock it for 5 to 10 minutes and start again. If a warning stays on, the system has a fault.

escalate.text: Book a service visit to read the driver-assistance fault memory.
tell_service: The speed and road where it happens
